description.value: Homebrew: marker effect present on the actor while shapeshifted into Weredragon's Animal form. Uses the same icon as the "Weredragon Form: Animal" hotbar macro. Granted automatically by that macro, the initiative form-shift prompt, or any other trigger that calls scripts/weredragon-form-shift.js's shiftWeredragonForm(actor, "animal") -- not meant to be dragged onto a sheet manually. Removed automatically when switching to Hybrid or Humanoid form.
